head: Your Discord chats could show up on Google
dek: Public chats in big Discord servers can appear on Google from mid-December, word for word (without usernames or avatars).
details: Don't want that? User Settings → Data & Privacy lets you opt out. In the EU and UK it stays off unless you switch it on.
means: What you write in a big public server could be read by anyone on Google, even without your name next to it.
todo: In Discord, open User Settings, then Data & Privacy, and opt out before mid-December. In the EU and UK it stays off unless you switch it on.
